allowed_changes: use exact frozen Binance BTCUSDT 1d data file
treat USDT as USD-equivalent only for this proxy and convert with latest historical usd_per_cny
restrict execution to common BTC/SP500 sessions for comparability with existing 252-session metrics
use T-1 BTC/CNY close versus exactly trailing 200 completed common-session closes
hold 100% BTC when strictly above SMA200, otherwise 100% CashYieldCNY
comparison_gates: Sharpe > BTC buy-and-hold on identical CNY/common-session window
expected_outputs: BTC SMA200, BTC buy-hold and cash CSVs
trade count, cash ratio, max gross, minimum cash and target fingerprint
follow_up_policy: After formal performance is viewed, do not change the 200-session horizon, add confirmation/hysteresis, switch data source, add another crypto asset, change weekend policy or transaction costs inside this lineage. Any crypto alternative is a separately preregistered economic hypothesis.
forbidden_changes: EMA, dual moving average, RSI, ATR, drawdown, halving, MVRV or volume confirmation
waiting bands, hysteresis, consecutive-day confirmation or stop-loss rescue
adding ETH, gold, QQQ, TLT or factor sleeves after results
using weekend execution after seeing weekday-only results
changing USDT/USD treatment or transaction costs after results
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage or gross exposure above 100%
hypothesis: Bitcoin has exhibited persistent multi-month trend regimes and extreme bear-market drawdowns. A single classic long-term trend rule—hold BTC only when the latest completed common-session BTC/CNY close is above its trailing 200 completed common-session simple moving average, otherwise hold CNY cash—may retain a meaningful portion of Bitcoin secular upside while avoiding enough prolonged downtrends to satisfy the same <=25% drawdown standard used for traditional-asset strategies, without leverage or shorting.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: Crypto time-series-momentum literature reports stronger evidence for time-series than cross-sectional momentum, while also warning about fat tails and parameter fragility
200-day simple moving average is chosen as an externally standard long-term trend convention; no moving-average period search is permitted
Recent research warns that fixed Bitcoin technical thresholds can decay, therefore this trial requires fixed-fold and global multiple-testing evidence rather than assuming historical persistence
selection_metric: No period search. Exactly one 200-common-session SMA rule. Validation, high-return objective and BTC buy-hold comparison are independent ATM-SVP-3 axes.
strategy_lineage: btc-sma200-001 / 比特币200日趋势001; independent crypto time-series trend with cash fallback
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_btc_sma200_001.py -> frozen Binance BTCUSDT daily data + historical USD/CNY + immutable tools/btc_sma200_001_logic.swift + SP500 calendar support -> BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace
validation_gates: measurement warnings for USDT≈USD and weekday execution are explicit
